title: Your apps
subtitle: Tap an app to open it.
noApps: Install something from the App Store and it will show up here.
installed: Installing {name} — it will appear on your Home.
installProgressWait: This takes a moment — it'll be ready shortly.
installProgressSlow: {name} is taking longer than usual. You can keep working — check on it from your apps.
noServer: You need a server to install apps.
remoteAccessBody: Open your apps from anywhere — secure HTTPS over Cloudflare, with no port-forwarding and no open ports on your box.

remoteAccessTokenHint: A token with Zone DNS + Cloudflare Tunnel permissions. Create one in the Cloudflare dashboard.
remoteAccessTurnOffConfirm: Turn off remote access? Your apps will only be reachable on the local network.
uninstallConfirm: Uninstall {name}? This removes the app and its data.
